cards.title: About GeoJSON Format
cards.body: GeoJSON is a JSON-based format for encoding geographic data structures, widely used in web mapping applications.

cards.title: About GPX Format
cards.body: GPX (GPS Exchange Format) is the standard XML format for GPS data, supported by most GPS devices and fitness trackers.
